title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
title_zh: OctoLong：在跨代码仓库上下文上进行中期训练以增强长上下文建模
abstract_en: Context lengths of language models (LMs) have dramatically increased, driven by the demands for in-context learning, self-improvement, and long-horizon agentic workflows. Existing long-context corpora, however, are dominated by books, academic articles, and code repositories, which are finite resources and often scarce in long-distance dependencies. In this work, we introduce OctoLong, a context engineering pipeline that instruments an AST parser, a language server backend, and a package manager to facilitate the recursive retrieval of code references, enabling the curation of dependency-rich code contexts of millions of tokens in length. We then train OctoLong-Instruct, a suite of capable long-context open LMs, derived from base models ranging in size from 600M to 14B parameters, via context-extension mid-training on a ~50B-token mixture containing ~6.2B tokens of OctoLong code contexts, followed by ~10B tokens of instruction tuning. Our training ablations and experimental evaluations against 18 state-of-the-art open-weight long-context LMs show that supplanting just 12% of traditional context-extension corpora with OctoLong data yields substantial gains in long-range retrieval, long-term state tracking, repository-level code understanding, and downstream agentic tasks, while also enhancing API usage in short-context coding scenarios.
abstract_zh: 随着上下文学习（in-context learning）、自我改进和长周期智能体工作流的需求增长，语言模型（LM）的上下文长度显著提升。然而，现有长上下文语料主要由书籍、学术论文和代码仓库构成，这些资源有限，且往往缺乏长距离依赖。本文提出 OctoLong：一种上下文工程流水线，结合 AST parser、language server backend 和 package manager，递归检索代码引用，从而构建长度可达数百万 token、依赖关系丰富的代码上下文。基于此，作者训练了 OctoLong-Instruct，一组开放权重长上下文语言模型，参数规模覆盖 600M 到 14B。训练流程包括在约 50B token 混合语料上进行上下文扩展中期训练，其中约 6.2B token 来自 OctoLong 代码上下文，随后再进行约 10B token 的指令微调。消融实验和对 18 个先进开放权重长上下文模型的评测表明，仅用 OctoLong 数据替换传统上下文扩展语料的 12%，即可在长程检索、长期状态跟踪、仓库级代码理解和下游智能体任务上带来显著提升，同时也改善短上下文代码场景中的 API 使用能力。
key_points_zh: OctoLong 通过 AST parser、language server backend 和 package manager 递归追踪代码引用，构建跨仓库、依赖密集、百万 token 级别的长代码上下文。
作者基于 600M 到 14B 参数的基础模型训练 OctoLong-Instruct，先进行约 50B token 的上下文扩展中期训练，再进行约 10B token 指令微调。
训练语料中仅约 6.2B token 来自 OctoLong，占传统上下文扩展语料替换比例约 12%，但带来明显性能增益。
相较 18 个先进开放权重长上下文 LM，OctoLong-Instruct 在长程检索、长期状态跟踪、仓库级代码理解和智能体任务上表现更强。
OctoLong 不只提升长上下文能力，也增强了短上下文代码生成场景中的 API 使用能力。

llm_assessment.comment: The data pipeline may help coding agents indirectly, but the paper is primarily long-context model training rather than agent harness evolution.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该数据管线可能间接帮助代码智能体，但论文核心仍是长上下文模型训练而非智能体运行框架演进。
